title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：newspaper　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 newspaper 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the painter ① read the newspaper that no visitor in the studio would have recorded, and he said the reading was the whole of the season. The ② newspaper, meaning the sheet itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a newspaper, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ newspaper in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ newspaper at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A newspaper, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the painter said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the newspaper was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the sheet. The ⑥ newspaper, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; newspaper, he said, is either something you read or the only word that means both a sheet and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ newspaper had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ newspaper of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of recording; newspaper, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ newspaper I remember is the sheet recorded in the catalogue, which closed in 1992 and is still recorded as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ newspaper, my mother said in 1994, is the only sheet that improves by being recorded; every newspaper, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like a sheet. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 报纸（指画室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 报纸（指那份报纸本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：read the newspaper 读这一份报纸
D. n. 报纸（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 报纸之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的报纸之事）
F. n. 报纸（指展品目录里写到、被记载的那一份）
G. n. 报纸、舆论（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 舆论（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: read the newspaper that no visitor in the studio would have recorded
The newspaper, meaning the sheet itself and not the brush
the newspaper at the far easel
the newspaper was the whole of the matter
the newspaper had become a line in a catalogue
The newspaper of the whole thing
A newspaper, my mother said in 1994

answers.why: read the newspaper 意为“读这一份报纸”，1985 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记载的一份报纸做了一遍。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，指那份报纸本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，指画室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
newspaper 意为“报纸、舆论”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份舆论就是那件事的全部。
newspaper 意为“舆论”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份报纸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，指展品目录里写到、被记载的那一份，到 1990 年这一份成了展品目录里的一行。
newspaper 意为“报纸之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的报纸之事是一处画室和三个季度的记载。
newspaper 意为“报纸”，我记得的是展品目录里记载过的那一份，1992 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一份。
newspaper 为抽象总称，母亲 1994 年说，报纸是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的报纸。
